note: Copilot & AI #22. No Microsoft tenant, no Azure. The two API keys are typed by the owner (not echoed) into this session only and never written anywhere; use the PAID-tier Gemini key (free-tier content is used to improve Google products). Cost is a few cents (the run prints its own estimate). Model names gpt-6.2-sol and gemini-3.8-flash and the prices in src/samples/prices.json must be re-checked on the recording day; pass --openai-model / --gemini-model if the projects have no access. A screen that needs a second capture of another kind lists it under 'then'.
prepare: if (-not $env:OPENAI_API_KEY) { $env:OPENAI_API_KEY = Read-Host 'OpenAI API key (owner types, not echoed)' -AsSecureString | ConvertFrom-SecureString -AsPlainText }
if (-not $env:GEMINI_API_KEY) { $env:GEMINI_API_KEY = Read-Host 'Gemini API key, paid tier (owner types, not echoed)' -AsSecureString | ConvertFrom-SecureString -AsPlainText }

screens.name: gemini-pricing-free-vs-paid
steps: Open the Gemini API pricing page and find Gemini 3.8 Flash
Select the Standard tab: show the free tier and paid tier columns
Show the row Used to improve our products: Yes for the free tier, No for the paid tier
Do not show the owner's keys or any signed-in console
mask: any signed-in account avatar in the browser window

teardown: # manual (owner): close the terminal so the key variables disappear and check the shell history has no key: Get-Content (Get-PSReadLineOption).HistorySavePath | Select-String KEY
# manual (owner): rotate or revoke either API key if it appeared in any recording; delete unused takes
prepare_local: $py = Get-PythonExe -Version 3.13; if (-not (Test-Path C:\MGLab\venv\copilot-22\Scripts\python.exe)) { & $py -m venv C:\MGLab\venv\copilot-22; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'venv failed' } }   # google-genai 3 needs Python 3.11+, the laptop's python is 3.10
$env:PATH = "C:\MGLab\venv\copilot-22\Scripts;$env:PATH"   # python = the 3.13 venv for this screen only (the queue restores PATH afterwards)
python -m pip install -r src/requirements.txt --quiet; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'pip install failed' }
python -m pytest -q | Out-Null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'the episode tests fail in the Python 3.13 venv' }
